result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the bottom navigation bar is broken: it is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, showing only the top of its icons with no labels, and the system home-gesture indicator overlaps the icons. The rest of the page (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousels, cards) renders normally.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar is clipped by the bottom edge of the screen. Only the upper part of the four icons (home, search, orders, profile) is visible, there are no labels, and the system gesture handle overlaps the search and orders icons. The bar appears to ignore the bottom safe-area inset or is positioned partly off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the navigation bar fully inside the viewport and add bottom safe-area padding (e.g. env(safe-area-inset-bottom) or window insets) so icons and labels are fully visible and sit above the gesture indicator.
